note: Prairie County, MT (30079) has no county-wide zoning. Its only zoning is one petitioned 'Last Best Place' zoning district (adopted Feb. 27 by the commission), whose boundary appears only as a map image in news coverage, with no queryable ArcGIS/WFS/bulk layer. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Prairie County zoning returned no zoning layer; the MSDI cadastral service carries parcels only. No city zoning layer found for Terry or other towns.
